keywords_glossary.Press: When this card enters play, apply Press to one rival card (it cannot act until end of turn unless written otherwise).
keywords_glossary.Wall: The next Threat this card would take is redirected to the Wall buffer instead.
keywords_glossary.Pulse: At end of turn, apply a small Resolve restore or Threat tick as written on the card.
keywords_glossary.Marker: Rivals cannot choose this card until it acts.
keywords_glossary.Deploy: This card may act the turn it enters play.
keywords_glossary.Link: If another allied card with Link is in play, gain the listed bonus.
keywords_glossary.Overload: Spend 1 extra mana when playing this card to double its enter effect.
keywords_glossary.Pinned: While Pinned is active on this card, it cannot act until end of turn.
keywords_glossary.Switch: Can influence distant cards without close engagement.
keywords_glossary.Hold: Rivals must engage this card before others when able.
keywords_glossary.Bootstrap: When this card enters play, draw a card or gain 1 Threat.
keywords_glossary.Recover: Restore Resolve to an allied card or yourself.
keywords_glossary.Echo: Repeats its pitch effect at end of turn.
keywords_glossary.Anchored: This card cannot be moved this turn.
keywords_glossary.Shape: This card holds the line — cannot be displaced while Resolve remains.
